name: Magnetism Rally
source:
Rei's going on a date. In your experience, this tends to be pretty disastrous, so you need to do your best job as her dog to prevent her from screwing up too badly.

[from [url=https://idaate.itch.io/magnetism-rally]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Rei要去約會了。根據你的經驗，這種事通常都會變成災難，所以，身為她的狗，你必須盡職盡責，別讓她搞砸得太厲害。

[摘自[url=https://idaate.itch.io/magnetism-rally]itch.io[/url]]
